options.minty_radar.title: MintyRadar Settings
options.minty_radar.show_map.tooltip: Show the radar map. When off, only the player list is shown, at the top of the screen.
options.minty_radar.compass.tooltip: Show N, E, S and W around the radar edge. North is highlighted in mint.
options.minty_radar.rings.tooltip: Circles at half and full radar range, labelled with their distance.
options.minty_radar.facing.tooltip: A short line on each player showing which way they're looking.
options.minty_radar.team_colors.tooltip: Frame and name players in their scoreboard team colour.
options.minty_radar.invisible.tooltip: Also show players and mobs that are invisible. They're marked (invisible) in the list. Many servers count this as cheating.
options.minty_radar.items.tooltip: Small yellow dots for items on the ground.
options.minty_radar.portals.tooltip: Purple squares on nether portals, end portals and end gateways in loaded chunks, including ones you can't see. Many servers count this as cheating.
options.minty_radar.trails.tooltip: Fading dots showing where each player has been.
options.minty_radar.terrain.tooltip: A top-down map of the loaded ground under the radar, in map colours with height shading.
options.minty_radar.cave_view.tooltip: Map the floor around your height instead of the surface. Always on in the Nether.
options.minty_radar.player_list.tooltip: List every player the radar can see, nearest first, with their distance. Mobs are never listed.
options.minty_radar.list_health.tooltip: Each player's health (with absorption) after their distance.
options.minty_radar.alert.tooltip: Show a message when a player comes within the alert distance. Friends never trigger it.
options.minty_radar.watch_only.tooltip: Only alert for the players on the watch list below.
options.minty_radar.move.title: Move Radar
options.minty_radar.move.hint: Drag the radar to move it
options.minty_radar.move.hint_list: Drag the box to move the player list
options.minty_radar.tab_ping.tooltip: Show each player's ping in milliseconds instead of signal bars. Your own ping is measured live every second. Other players' pings come from the server, which updates them every few seconds.
